author: /root/evidence_audit

execution_source.source_scope: Completed evidence belongs to frozen25b1. Current independent source/test/workflow corrections are intentionally excluded; no newer-SHA runtime or final readiness claim.

totals.manifest_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON, ensure_ascii=true, separators comma/colon, sorted rows [path, git_mode, sha256, bytes]; report itself excluded.

sensitive_signature_scan.method: Bounded standard-library byte regex inspection of every exact file, decoded JSON strings, all nonencrypted ZIP members and decoded gzip data. No project scanner/tests/native commands or network services executed. Matching content is never echoed or retained.
limitations: No matched signature is not proof that arbitrary encoded, unknown-format or low-entropy credentials are absent. No global caches, credentials or unrelated work were inspected.
Ordinary source paths, hosted runner identities, synthetic simulator UUIDs and public publisher/author metadata remain retained evidence, not automatically secrets.
The scope is delivery safety, not application runtime, native recovery/provenance, owner/legal approval, or final readiness.

independent_review_bindings.scope: Existing evidence reviews are preserved; this safety inventory does not grant approval to pending source corrections or workflow dispatches.

critical_ignored_raw_logs.required_action: Coordinator must explicitly preserve/add these reviewed raw log paths despite the ignore rule; ordinary directory git add omits them. Rehash exact manifest immediately before approved staging. Never use broad force-add on the repository or mixed source-draft directories.

staging_notes.selection_policy: Use only these exact file rows and separately the final safety report after review; a directory allowlist is discovery context, not permission to include later arrivals. The report does not stage any path or freeze/commit source.

preexisting_task_owned_lock.disposition: EXCLUDED; neither staged nor removed. Existence alone is not a claim of active or orphaned ownership.

exclusions_and_preservation.unrelated_and_global_policy: No source/configuration/signing files, caches, unrelated stashes or user work removed, replaced, staged or recursively scanned. Existing task-owned generated cleanup/evidence remain untouched. Excluded native/source/test drafts belong to their authors and require their own review/freeze.

work_and_cleanup.gradle_stop: Not run: no Gradle/build/test cycle was started; do not interfere with coordinator lanes.
work_and_cleanup.cleanup: No temporary files or generated outputs created; only this requested new untracked report. Originals, failed receipts, archives, extracted bytes, lock and unrelated work preserved.

readiness_limit: Native17/18 remain FAIL before app/Parlorlibproc execution; C25b1 scope is historical after new controls freeze; D/physical/Store/owner/legal obligations are not passed by a safe evidence delivery inventory.
